Our generated terrain-test map (its Blueprint is frozen in `../../terrain-test/`), opened in StarCraft II Editor 5.0.17 on 2026-10-27, with one
Agria water area painted over the level-0 pit (cells 20-36 × 56-72), 4 cells wider than the pit on each
side so the waves reach the cliff. Saved byte-for-byte as the Editor wrote them: `t3Water` (the area) and
`WaterData.xml` (the map-local Agria override the Editor added, height 5.9).
